name: Cultural Time Machine
tagline: From the first stone tools and the Ice Age to Rome, the Mughals, the East India Company, two world wars and today: every era, empire, people, festival, belief and invention, with how people lived, what they ate and the species they shared the world with.
footer: An independent history encyclopedia built from archaeology, ancient DNA, primary sources and peer-reviewed research. Part of the AI Cultural Time Machine project.

sections.title: Human Origins & the Ice Age
sections.desc: From the first hominins and the ice ages to the spread of modern humans and the invention of farming.

sections.title: The Ancient World
sections.desc: The first cities and empires, Bronze Age collapse, the Axial Age and the rise and fall of Rome.

sections.title: History of India
sections.desc: From Bhimbetka and the Indus to the Mauryas, Guptas, Cholas, Sultanate, Mughals and Marathas, the East India Company, the Raj and Independence.

sections.title: The Medieval & Early Modern World
sections.desc: The Silk Road, the Islamic Golden Age, the Mongols, plagues and the Age of Exploration.

sections.title: The Modern World
sections.desc: The Industrial Revolution, the world wars and decolonisation.

sections.title: Daily Life Through Time
sections.desc: How ordinary people lived, dressed, ate, worked and celebrated in every age.

sections.title: Data & Tracker
sections.desc: Live archaeology tracker and open datasets.

collections.title: Eras & Ages
collections.short: From Pangaea to the Information Age
collections.desc: Every era from deep time and human origins through the Ice Age, farming, the Bronze and Iron Ages, the classical, medieval and early modern worlds to today: how people lived, what they ate and which species shared their world.
collections.prompt: Photorealistic, historically accurate reconstruction of everyday life during the {name} ({when}) in {region}: people, dwellings, tools, food and landscape, documentary film still, natural light, 16:9, no text

collections.title: Civilisations & Empires
collections.short: 86 civilisations from Sumer to the USSR
collections.desc: Civilisations, kingdoms and empires of every continent: when they flourished, their capitals, what they are known for, how ordinary people lived and what they ate.
collections.prompt: Photorealistic, historically accurate reconstruction of a busy street or court in the {name} ({when}) at its height in {region}, with period clothing, architecture and daily life, cinematic, 16:9, no text

collections.title: Events That Shaped History
collections.desc: Ice ages, continental drift, eruptions, droughts, plagues and pandemics, conquests, revolutions, the East India Company, the 1857 uprising, the world wars, Partition and more.
collections.prompt: Photorealistic, historically accurate documentary-style depiction of the {name} ({when}), {region}, cinematic, no gore, 16:9, no text

collections.title: People of History
collections.desc: Rulers and conquerors, freedom fighters, philosophers, scientists, poets and reformers from every age, with India's in depth.
collections.prompt: Painterly, historically accurate portrait of {name} ({lived}), {role} of {region}, period clothing and setting, museum-quality oil painting style, 4:5, no text

collections.title: Wonders & Archaeological Sites
collections.desc: Archaeological sites, temples, cities, tombs, forts and wonders, from Göbekli Tepe and Dholavira to Angkor Wat and the Taj Mahal.
collections.prompt: Photorealistic photograph of {name} in {country} as it stands today, golden hour, wide angle, 16:9, no text

collections.title: Peoples & Tribes
collections.desc: India's Adivasi communities and Indigenous and ancient peoples worldwide: how they live and lived, what they eat, and their culture.
collections.prompt: Respectful, photorealistic documentary photograph of the traditional landscape, dwellings and crafts of the {name} ({region}), no identifiable individuals, 16:9, no text

collections.title: Festivals & Celebrations
collections.short: Diwali to Day of the Dead
collections.desc: Festivals of India and the world, ancient and living: origins, how they are celebrated and the food that goes with them.
collections.prompt: Vibrant photorealistic photograph of {name} celebrations ({how}), festive atmosphere, 16:9, no text

collections.title: Religions, Philosophies & Scripts
collections.desc: The world's religions and philosophies, and the writing systems that recorded history, from cuneiform and Brahmi to Hangul and Ol Chiki.
collections.prompt: Photorealistic photograph of an ancient artefact or sacred site representing {name}, museum lighting, 16:9, no text

collections.title: Inventions & Discoveries
collections.desc: The inventions that changed human life, with the many from India: zero, wootz steel, crystallised sugar, cotton textiles, Mysorean rockets and UPI.
collections.prompt: Photorealistic museum photograph of an early example of the {name}, {where}, dramatic lighting, 16:9, no text

collections.title: Species of Past Ages
collections.desc: Animals that lived alongside our ancestors and vanished: Ice Age megafauna, island giants and species driven extinct in historical times.
collections.prompt: Photorealistic, scientifically accurate reconstruction of a living {name} ({scientific}) in its natural habitat in {region}, wildlife documentary still, 16:9, no text

collections.title: Research Papers
collections.desc: Landmark papers in archaeology, ancient DNA and climate history. Openly licensed ones open in the built-in PDF reader.
